content.comment_body: How many slave devices can be connected via [product_name] [product_name] using MODBUS RTU (RS485) when it is configured as the master?
Please refer to the manual, page 64.
So, what is the maximum number of slave devices allowed on one network?

The details are unclear. I found information suggesting up to 32 slaves are possible, but in practice, the software only permits configuring up to 16 slaves—one per configuration row. This makes it quite restrictive.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for specific guidance regarding the limit of slave devices that can be connected using [product_name] with MODBUS RTU in master mode. Although documentation is mentioned, it lacks explicit answers, leading to confusion. A user notes that while theoretically 32 slaves should be supported, the software only allows up to 16 devices due to configuration constraints, indicating a gap between documentation and real-world usage.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the documentation to clearly state both the theoretical and actual limits for the number of slave devices supported in MODBUS RTU master mode with [product_name], including any practical constraints imposed by the configuration software.
